# Test-determinism gate allowlist, one entry per function.
# Format: relpath<TAB>function<TAB>rule<TAB>reason
# An entry suppresses the findings of RULE inside FUNCTION of RELPATH only: a new finding in another
# function of the same file still fails. `function` is what --json and each finding line print after
# 'in' (Python `Class.method`, Swift `Type.method`, a JS test's title path, or <module>).
# --strict fails on an entry that no longer matches any finding ("stale entry"): delete it.
# A reason that starts with 'hang guard:' marks a deadline-only bound, well above any normal run, that
# exists so a hang fails instead of stalling CI; it says what would hang. Every other entry is old debt:
# tests/test_determinism_allowlist_ratchet.py lets that debt only shrink. Fix a new finding (a recorded
# clock, a real completion signal, or the n-vs-4n scaling ratio) instead of listing it.
